title: Drop Biscuits
ingredients: 1 stick unsalted butter, cut into 1/4 inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F and cover a sheet pan with parchment paper.
In a mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Toss butter into he mix until it is coated with flour.
Working quickly amd using one's fingers, rub or cut the butter into the flour until it resembles a coarse meal.
Add milk and stir with a fork until it just comes together into a sticky, shaggy dough.
Use an ice cream scoop to drop dough onto the baking sheet.
Bake for 20-22 minutes. If the tops do not seem done, broil on high for 1 minute.
Remove from the oven when golden-brown and allow to cool slightly on a wire rack before serving.
